chunks: From him, from Muhammad ibn Nusayr, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
He was asked about the dripping of urine, and he said: 'He places a cloth when he prays.'

key_terms.خَرِيطَةً: A piece of cloth or rag

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for urine that drips on clothing during prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith from the chapter of the 'Prayer of the Necessity' (Salat al-Mudtirri) outlines the principle of *al-rukhsah* (concession) for those unable to perform full *istinja* (purification from urine). By placing a cloth (*kharitah*) over the affected area, the impurity is contained, allowing the prayer to be valid despite the residual trace, reflecting the Shia juristic emphasis on removing the burden of hardship.
